header.title: People
header.scope: Oct 2026 vs Sep 2026 · Whole agency · 5 people

info.name: Team utilisation
info.definition: Utilisation (C3) for the people in view: standard hours as a share of capacity.

kpis.label: Client-work share

info.name: Client-work share
info.definition: Hours on client projects as a share of all hours, over the same people as utilisation.
info.formula: hours on client projects ÷ all hours

kpis.sub: Hours on client projects, of all hours

kpis.label: Overtime

info.name: Overtime
info.definition: Hours beyond the day's length: on production days, and on standard days over the length, person by person.
info.formula: Σ per person per day: max(0, production − day) + max(0, standard − day)

kpis.sub: Beyond the day's length, production days and standard ones

kpis.label: Burnout risk

info.name: Burnout risk
info.definition: People above their whole weekly capacity for at least the number of weeks running set in Settings, in weeks ending inside the period.
info.formula: count of people with ≥ N consecutive weeks of standard hours > weekly capacity
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

kpis.sub: Over their whole weekly capacity 3+ weeks running

kpis.label: Leave used

info.name: Leave used
info.definition: Annual leave taken this year to the end of the period, as a share of the year's entitlement, beside the share of the year gone. Watch when it trails the year by more than 25 points.
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

kpis.sub: Annual leave taken, of the year’s entitlement

people.title: Utilisation by person
people.subtitle: Oct 2026 · the shaded band is 65%–80% (Settings) · the chip is green when it moves toward the band

info.name: Utilisation
info.definition: Standard hours (all but production-day hours) as a share of capacity, for the people with capacity in the period. Nothing logged is "No data", never a good figure.

leave.title: Leave left this year
leave.subtitle: Annual leave, 2026, to 31 Oct 2026 · amber: more than 25 points behind the 83% of the year gone

info.name: Leave used
info.definition: Annual leave taken this year to the end of the period, as a share of the year's entitlement, beside the share of the year gone. Watch when it trails the year by more than 25 points.
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

internal.title: Internal time by department
internal.subtitle: Personal and internal hours as a share of all hours, Oct 2026 · totals only, never per person

info.name: Internal time
info.definition: Personal and internal hours as a share of all hours (an internal project has no client). Totals only: personal time is never shown per person.
info.formula: personal and internal hours ÷ all hours
